matter_background.original: Upali de Silva executed a Deed of Gift subject to his Life Interest gifting his property situated in Battaramulla in extent of 30 perches with a house standing thereon to his 3 sons Asanka, Sasanka and Kanishka. Asanka wishes to sell his share and purchase an Apartment in Colombo. Sasanka wishes to obtain a housing loan and build a house on his share. Kanishka wishes to live in the house built on the land.
